_comment: OPTIONAL editorial layer, keyed by module name, merged OVER the autoloaded manifest. Every fact (title, version, icon, description, signer) is read from index.json automatically — this file only exists for things a manifest can't know. All keys optional; delete this file entirely and the catalog still renders. Supported keys per module: featured (bool, floats to top), bucket (string, overrides the category grouping), blurb (string, longer marketing copy than the manifest description), homepage (string, links the title).
